column1: # The size budget (D020, 0122): gzip -9 of the shipped djs-wasm module (scripts/build-wasm.sh)
# must stay within 1.5x quickjs-wasi's. The gate's last step checks it with
# scripts/size/budget.py; until the module is within 1.5x, `ceiling_gzip` is a ratchet
# (lowered with --update, raised only by a recorded decision; last raised: D2892, 0204: the
# shipped module loads plain dumps itself; lowered by 0177, D2704: images are no persistence
# format, so the shipped module verifies none; lowered by 0225, D3090: core and alloc built for the module,
# panics abort without a message; lowered by 0226, D3100: the shipped and slim modules read the
# arena unchecked; raised by 0230, D3123: builtins' helpers inlined, pure leaves in the hot loop; raised by 0232,
# D3133: await, async return and Promise combinators without builtin calls; raised by 0231, D3127: sort, Map/Set, string +, push, join and
# Array.from fast paths, +0.9 KB; raised by 0232b,
# D3159: lazy internal closures, @fast resolving functions and then; raised by 0236, D3164: the
# slim_ceiling_gzip: the slim module (scripts/build-wasm.sh --slim, D2411), its own ratchet.
